long_description:
✨ Ready to deepen your intuition and open your heart center? ✨

Join us at Divine Spark for the Source Energy Exchange: Heart & Third-Eye Activation! 👁️💖

This guided, experiential session is designed to help you slow down, get grounded, and receive intentional energy work in a safe, supportive environment.

What to expect:

🌟 Grounding & Shielding: Settle into the space with an intentional energetic practice.

🌟 Individual Activation: Receive a targeted Heart and Third-Eye energy activation to align your intuition and heart center.

🌟 Quantum Healing Energy Exchange: A deeper chakra-clearing experience allowing for personal integration, deep relaxation, and energetic shifts.

🧘‍♀️ Meet Your Facilitator:

This session is facilitated by Donna Werge, Reiki Master Teacher, Certified Spiritual Coach, Quantum Healing/Energy Practitioner, and founder of Healing for the Soul’s Calling. Donna brings over 6 years of experience teaching Usui Reiki and guiding clients through intuitive energy work. Her gentle approach creates a space where each person’s unique experience can naturally unfold.

📅 Date: Saturday, October 24th at 10:30 AM

⏰ Duration: 1 Hour

📍 Location: Divine Spark (2567 Homeview Dr, Richmond, VA)

🎟️ Investment: $35

✨ Space is limited to 17 participants—reserve your spot today!

👉 Sign up here: https://www.divinesparkva.com/source-energy-third-eye-heart-activation
